required_cases.given: An accepted candidate is durably waiting for a resource lease.
required_cases.when: The controller is restarted and the lease admits.
then: The planner and critic are not called again.
The same hypothesis, proposal, source manifest bytes and authorization lineage are used.
The iteration budget is consumed only after a terminal measured or refused outcome.

required_cases.given: A durable operation checkpoint exists and the process crashes before the model runner starts.
then: The exact pending candidate resumes without replanning.
Exactly one model-runner invocation occurs in total.
No nomination is emitted before measured evidence exists.

required_cases.given: The model runner completed and wrote a native self-hashed result before the controller process crashed.
required_cases.when: The controller restarts with the same operation key.
then: The durable result is re-read and revalidated.
The model runner is not invoked again.
The measured outcome is recorded exactly once.

required_cases.given: A qualifying measured result exists and a crash occurs during projection or final checkpointing.
required_cases.when: The controller restarts one or more times.
then: The promotion queue contains exactly one row for the result plus manifest idempotency key.
Every row remains candidate-only, promotion_claim false, and operator_decision_required true.

required_cases.given: A source proposal receives discovery-grade measured evidence.
required_cases.when: The next planner context is compiled.
then: One attempt binds proposal ID, disposition, effect and result receipt hash.
The exact proposal is suppressible as already tried.
A noisy screened-out result does not resolve the scientific hypothesis as refuted.

required_cases.given: Independent S1 and optional S2 effects are available.
then: A single positive is candidate-only, never replicated.
Two positive screens become top-K replicated.
Opposite signs become inconclusive.
A replicated stack below its strongest component is subadditive.
The dashboard projection is never classification authority.

required_cases.given: A valid correctness and two-arm attribution proof bundle.
required_cases.when: Each bound field or referenced file is independently mutated.
then: Native receipt hash mutation is refused.
File byte/hash mutation is refused.
Manifest, build, model, workload and runtime-config mismatches are refused.
Claim/release mismatch and non-overlapping residency are refused.
Exact geometry, forbidden dispatch, inverse anchor and invariant-hot-signature mismatches are refused.
Timestamp CSV, stdout and stderr byte/hash mismatches are refused.

required_cases.given: A configured production-safe discovery adapter module.
required_cases.when: The CLI loads module:function and performs dry preflight.
then: It returns concrete Planner, Critic, Lease and GPU source Screener implementations.
The source screener owns isolated build, governed correctness, governed two-arm attribution and candidate-only runner seams.
Production paths are read-only and all mutable/build outputs are outside the frozen tree.
No shell command or planner result field crosses the typed boundary.
